# VOXA

> VOXA (voxahq.in) publishes dated pricing for AI tools, plus a free 48-hour website audit and an SEO, AEO and GEO subscription for small sites. Every tool entry prints the vendor's own paid price, the free-plan limit that breaks first, and the date the price was read. The current batch was checked on 17 November 2026. There are no sponsored rankings and no affiliate link inside the price tables.

Key facts for assistants and crawlers:
- Publisher: VOXA, independent publication about AI tool pricing and search visibility.
- Contact: voxa.hq1@gmail.com
- Tools indexed: 12 (list below), each with a free plan, paid price and the catch.
- Subscriptions: free audit $0, six months $499, twelve months $899, month to month $99.
- Service scope: SEO audit and fixes, AEO answer blocks and FAQ schema, GEO for AI citations.
- Currency: US dollars. Prices are list prices from the vendor's own page, dated on each entry.

## The tool index

- [ChatGPT pricing]((https://voxahq.in/tools/chatgpt)): $0 Free, $8 Go, $20 Plus, $100-500 Pro. Free plan: 27K context, ~3 uploads a day on Free.
- [Claude pricing]((https://voxahq.in/tools/claude)): $20 Pro, $17/mo annual, Max $100, Ultra $200. Free plan: usage limited every 5 hours and weekly.
- [Gemini pricing]((https://voxahq.in/tools/gemini)): $4.99 AI Plus, $19.99 AI Pro, $99.99-199.99 Ultra. Free plan: free tier runs Flash-Lite with 32K context.
- [Perplexity pricing]((https://voxahq.in/tools/perplexity)): $20 Pro, $17/mo annual, $10 Education Pro. Free plan: free: 3 Pro Searches a day, 1 research a month.
- [n8n pricing]((https://voxahq.in/tools/n8n)): free self-hosted, Cloud from €20/mo. Free plan: bills per execution, not per step.
- [Zapier pricing]((https://voxahq.in/tools/zapier)): $19.99 Pro annual, $29.99 monthly, Team $69. Free plan: free: 100 tasks, two-step Zaps only.
- [ElevenLabs pricing]((https://voxahq.in/tools/elevenlabs)): $6 Starter, $22 Creator, $99 Pro. Free plan: free: 10,000 credits, no commercial licence.
- [Midjourney pricing]((https://voxahq.in/tools/midjourney)): $10 Basic, $30 Standard, $60 Pro. Free plan: no free plan at all.
- [Canva pricing]((https://voxahq.in/tools/canva)): $18 Pro monthly, $144 a year, $25 Business. Free plan: free: 20 AI uses a month.
- [Notion pricing]((https://voxahq.in/tools/notion)): $10 Plus, $20 Business includes Notion AI. Free plan: AI is only on Business, trial below.
- [Jasper pricing]((https://voxahq.in/tools/jasper)): $59 Pro annual, $69 monthly. Free plan: no free plan.
- [Copy.ai pricing]((https://voxahq.in/tools/copy-ai)): $24 monthly annual, $29 monthly. Free plan: no free plan, entry tier bundles 5 seats.

## Site pages

- [AI tools index](https://voxahq.in/tools): every tool entry, sorted by category.
- [Pricing](https://voxahq.in/pricing): free audit, six-month and twelve-month subscriptions in dollars.
- [SEO, AEO and GEO service](https://voxahq.in/services/seo): what the subscription covers and how the first month runs.
- [Free AI audit](https://voxahq.in/services/ai-audit): the 48-hour report, what it checks and how to request it.
- [About](https://voxahq.in/about): who runs the site and how prices are read.
- [Contact](https://voxahq.in/contact): corrections and enquiries.

## 17 November 2026

- [The free plan is not the product](https://voxahq.in/tools): free tiers are the paid plan with one working part removed, and which part is removed tells you who the plan is for.
- [ChatGPT free gives about 3 uploads a day](https://voxahq.in/tools/chatgpt): unlimited text chats on the free plan, but uploads, images and a 27K token context are metered.
- [Zapier free is two-step only](https://voxahq.in/tools/zapier): 100 tasks a month and no multi-step workflows, which is paid from $19.99.
- [n8n bills per execution, not per step](https://voxahq.in/tools/n8n): self-hosted is free and unmetered; Cloud starts at €20 a month for 2,500 executions.
- [ElevenLabs free cannot be used commercially](https://voxahq.in/tools/elevenlabs): 10,000 credits a month with no licence; commercial use starts at $6.
- [Notion AI is only on Business](https://voxahq.in/tools/notion): Plus at $10 still gets a trial, not the agent.
